channel.desc: Wanting a new start in Devon, a couple with a budget of ?650,000 enlist Jules Hudson's house hunting knowhow to find a detached family home with a large garden for their two young children and some income potential. Whilst in the county, Jules gets stuck into some woodcraft using nothing but steam to sculpt some impressive interior design pieces.
